coverage_notes: The agreement concerns Data and computational-analysis Results, not necessarily software, and its Data Recipient grant is expressly conditioned on following the agreement.

Clause 1.2 says the agreement imposes no restriction on portions of Data usable under public-domain status or another legal exception or limitation; it does not create those independent legal bases, so no permission is inferred from it.

Commercial use, charging, paid access, network provision, source provision, sublicensing, training, and other listed activities are not expressly granted or restricted in the supplied operative clauses.
Warranty and liability terms and definitions were reviewed but do not add activity permissions or obligations within the requested ASC categories.
